title: Better AI Answers Start with Better Follow-Up Prompts | Ep 10
description:
Better AI Answers Start with Better Follow-Up Prompts. Learn with a simple example and a beginner exercise.

AI for Beginners — Episode 10 of 50

What you will learn: Improve outputs through targeted revisions.
Example: shortening a long explanation to five bullet points.
Try it: ask for a shorter version and a simpler example.
Remember: review every revision for lost facts.

Follow the series in episode order and practice with sample data. Share your question or exercise result in the comments.
